_comment: Content Security Policy baseline for DoNotDev apps. Copy the relevant directives into your hosting config (vercel.json headers, netlify _headers, etc.).

_supabase._comment: Add these if your app uses Supabase

_firebase._comment: Add these if your app uses Firebase

_google_maps._comment: Add these if your app uses Google Maps (AddressField)

_google_oauth._comment: Add these if your app uses Google OAuth

_rules: NEVER mix 'none' with URLs in the same directive (e.g., frame-src 'none' https://... is invalid)
NEVER use 'unsafe-eval' — Vite HMR works without it in dev, production never needs it
Merge connect-src values from all providers you use into a single directive
credentials: 'omit' is set by the framework on cross-origin fetches — CSP does not need to allow cookies for these
